title: Elegant Smoky French Cheese Quiche
description: A light and crispy French quiche featuring shredded Mexican cheese with a smoky twist, perfect for a tamasic-friendly meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the pie crust and place it in a tart pan with a removable bottom.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, heavy cream, salt, and black pepper.
Add the shredded Mexican cheese, smoked paprika, and hot sauce to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Pour the egg mixture into the pie crust.
Sprinkle the chopped fresh parsley over the top of the quiche.
Bake the quiche for 35 minutes or until the edges are golden brown and the center is set.
Remove the quiche from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
